blocks.prompt: 4 Find a unit vector in the direction of \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
Unit vector woh vector hai jis ki lambai bilkul 1 ho aur direction wahi ho jo \(\underline{v}\) ki hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\hat{v} = \underline{v}/|\underline{v}|\).
Plan: pehle \(\underline{v}\) ki lambai, phir har component ko us se divide. Socho jaise ek lambi chhari ko kaat kar 1 unit ki bana diya, lekin rukh (direction) wahi rakha.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{v}\) ki direction mein unit vector \(\hat{v}\).
Tareeqa: \(\hat{v} = \underline{v}/|\underline{v}|\). Kisi vector ko us ki apni lambai se divide karein to lambai 1 ho jati hai, aur positive number se divide karne se direction nahi badalti.

\(|\underline{v}|\) nikalein
\[|\underline{v}| = \sqrt{(-1)^2 + 4^2 + (-8)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{1 + 16 + 64}\]
\[= \sqrt{81} = 9\]
Kyun: Magnitude ka formula lagaya. Teeno squares positive hain: \(1 + 16 + 64 = 81\), aur \(\sqrt{81} = 9\) ek saaf number hai.

9 se divide karein
\[\hat{v} = \dfrac{-\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}}{9}\]
\[= -\dfrac{1}{9}\underline{i} + \dfrac{4}{9}\underline{j} - \dfrac{8}{9}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har component ko alag alag 9 se divide kiya; signs wahi rahe kyunke 9 positive hai.

Lambai check karein
\[\dfrac{1}{81} + \dfrac{16}{81} + \dfrac{64}{81} = 1\]
\[|\hat{v}| = \sqrt{1} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Unit vector ki lambai bilkul 1 honi chahiye. Squares ka jama \(81/81 = 1\) aaya, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\hat{v} = -\frac{1}{9}\underline{i} + \frac{4}{9}\underline{j} - \frac{8}{9}\underline{k}\)
Unit vector ke components hi \(\underline{v}\) ke direction cosines hain.
